create_link.title: Create Short Link
create_link.description: Shorten a URL into a y.gy short link, optionally with a custom domain/suffix, password, expiry, social preview, device-specific destinations, tags and click webhook. Returns the link object with its id, short URL and QR code URLs.

destination_url.description: URL the short link redirects to.

domain.description: Short-link domain; defaults to y.gy. Custom domains must be verified in the dashboard first.

suffix.description: Custom back-half of the short link, e.g. '123' gives y.gy/123. Random when omitted.

password.description: Password that visitors must enter before being redirected.

og_title.description: Title shown in social-media link previews.

og_description.description: Description shown in social-media link previews.

og_image.description: Image URL shown in social-media link previews.

expiration_date.description: Datetime after which the short link stops working.

qr_code_foreground_hex.description: QR code foreground colour as hex, e.g. #CF245A.

qr_code_background_hex.description: QR code background colour as hex, e.g. #FFFFFF.

name.description: Optional internal name/title for the link.

android_link_destination.description: Destination URL used for visitors on Android devices.

ios_link_destination.description: Destination URL used for visitors on iOS devices.

webhook_url.description: URL that receives real-time click events via webhook.

webhook_auth_key.description: Authentication key used to secure webhook deliveries.

tags.description: Tag ids (from list_tags) to attach to the link.

disable_png.description: Set true to skip generating the PNG QR code (only SVG), which makes bulk creation much faster.

get_link.title: Get Short Link
get_link.description: Fetch one short link by its numeric id, returning destination, short URL, tags, QR codes and settings. Use list_links to find ids.

id.description: Id of the link as returned by y.gy.

list_links.title: List Short Links
list_links.description: List the account's short links with offset pagination. Returns an object holding an array of link objects and the total count.

offset.description: Number of links to skip before returning results.

update_link.title: Update Short Link
update_link.description: Patch an existing short link: change its destination, password, expiry, preview metadata, QR colours, device destinations, webhook, bot protection/captcha, or add/remove tags. Only provided fields change. Returns the updated link.

id.description: Id of the link to update.

password.description: Password that visitors must enter before being redirected.

og_title.description: Title shown in social-media link previews.

og_description.description: Description shown in social-media link previews.

og_image.description: Image URL shown in social-media link previews.

expiration_date.description: Datetime after which the short link stops working.

qr_code_foreground_hex.description: QR code foreground colour as hex, e.g. #CF245A.

qr_code_background_hex.description: QR code background colour as hex, e.g. #FFFFFF.

name.description: Optional internal name/title for the link.

android_link_destination.description: Destination URL used for visitors on Android devices.

ios_link_destination.description: Destination URL used for visitors on iOS devices.

webhook_url.description: URL that receives real-time click events via webhook.

webhook_auth_key.description: Authentication key used to secure webhook deliveries.

add_tags.description: Tag ids to add to the link.

remove_tags.description: Tag ids to remove from the link.

bot_protection.description: Enable bot protection on the link.

delete_link.title: Delete Short Link
delete_link.description: Permanently delete a short link by id; the short URL stops redirecting. Returns HTTP 204 with no body.

id.description: Id of the link to delete.

create_tag.title: Create Tag
create_tag.description: Create a tag used to group short links into categories. Returns the tag object including its id, which can be passed in tags/add_tags on links.

list_tags.title: List Tags
list_tags.description: List every tag in the account. Returns an array of tag objects (id and name); use the ids when tagging links.

delete_tag.title: Delete Tag
delete_tag.description: Delete a tag by its id. Links keep existing but lose the tag. Returns HTTP 204.

id.description: Id of the tag to delete.
